title: A manager links a POS operator, and that operator clocks a shift onto the attendance table

steps.name: sign in as the manager and open the roster
the roster offers the link, and says who cannot clock today
steps.detail: Kari Hansen #1 Kan stemple – koblet til Kari Hansen | Ola Ansatt #2 Kan ikke stemple – ingen kobling

steps.name: choosing Ola shows both sides of the binding before it is made
steps.detail: Det blir opprettet en ny person med dette navnet, og en ansettelse under valgt arbeidsgiver. Ansettelsen får bare tilgang til sitt eget – ingen lederrettigheter.

steps.name: the import runs, and the receipt names the person, not a guid
the engagement itself now states the register link
steps.detail: Koblet til kasseoperatør #2. Stemplinger fra den operatøren blir denne ansettelsens timer.

steps.name: become the register: sign in as the person who runs the till
steps.detail: the register is at its PIN screen

steps.name: Ola signs in with his PIN — the operator the clock journey could not clock
steps.detail: operator session open for Ola Ansatt

steps.name: he clocks in, and the register is not refused
steps.detail: Du er stemplet inn. Økta står åpen fra 16:58.

steps.name: a minute later he clocks out, and the window closes
steps.detail: Du er stemplet ut. Økta er ført 16:58–16:59.

steps.name: the manager reads the hours back off the attendance table
